summary.text: Nick Boldyga is a Republican state representative from Southwick who has represented the 3rd Hampden District since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Southwick selectman and parks and recreation commissioner, he advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Boldyga graduated from Lenox Memorial High School and Western New England College, where he earned a degree in accounting, and he is a graduate of the Connecticut State Police Academy and the Western Massachusetts Reserve Police Academy.
He served as Southwick's parks and recreation commissioner and as a selectman, and lists his profession as legislator and auxiliary police officer.
Boldyga has served in the Massachusetts House since 2011.

He is ranking minority member of the House Committee on Human Resources and Employee Engagement and of the Joint Committees on Aging and Independence and on Agriculture and Fisheries, and he serves on the Joint Committee on Revenue.
